strategies_monthly_review: Reviewed monthly, at the close of the last trading day of each month.

strategies_official_results_note: Official results for each round. Points summarize the comparison with the S&P 500 at the close.
strategies_no_round_results: It doesn't have any round results yet.
strategies_user_strategy_disclaimer: This is a user's strategy, not a recommendation from the platform. Everything is simulated: no trades are made here.
strategies_pro_copy_note: With Pro, you can copy this strategy and customize it.
strategies_copy_requires_published_pro: You can copy the methodology with Pro once its author publishes it.
strategies_showcase_intro: _ui components with made-up sample values for this page only. Not available in production.
strategies_showcase_account_note: The two app headers, with the account menu behind the three dots (it opens on tap).
strategies_showcase_crest_note: Shapes and patterns, plus the three house teams and their symbols.
strategies_showcase_low_debt_note: net debt below two years of operating profit
strategies_showcase_raised_card_note: floats above the background with a shadow
strategies_showcase_not_playing_note: Create a strategy today to join the next round and start fresh like everyone else.
strategies_showcase_server_error: The server didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
strategies_sharpe_help: Relates portfolio return to variation. A higher value means more return per unit of risk; the risk-free reference is 0%.
strategies_sortino_help: Relates return to downside moves instead of all variation. Minimum target: 0%.
strategies_volatility_help: How much returns fluctuate. Higher volatility means larger swings; annualized figure.
strategies_drawdown_help: The largest drop from a previous high in the curve over the period shown.
strategies_chart_insufficient_data: There aren't enough sessions to draw the curve yet.
strategies_chart_aria: Strategy total return curve compared with the S&P 500
strategies_daily_performance_private: Daily history is available to the owner and to Pro accounts for published strategies.
strategies_daily_performance_empty: There isn't a complete set of closing prices to calculate the curve and its metrics yet.
strategies_position_summary_help: The largest position's weight shows how much the portfolio depends on one company. Cash is the uninvested portion.
strategies_total_performance_help: Curve recalculated from saved closes, dividends, and splits; it may differ from an official round result. The open month is provisional.
strategies_distribution_help: The number of positions, the largest position's weight, and the uninvested portion. A high weight in a few companies concentrates risk.
strategies_observations_missing: Missing observations: {count} of {total} needed for Sharpe, Sortino, and volatility.
strategies_incomplete_series_note: Some sessions have no saved close, or a round lacks its complete baseline or final data. The curve marks gaps, and daily metrics exclude those intervals.
strategies_evidence_manual_exclusion: This formation's recipe explicitly excludes this company.
strategies_evidence_method_changed: The methodology changed for this formation, so the exit isn't attributed to a specific rule.
strategies_evidence_rule_failed: It doesn't pass every rule in the new formation's snapshot.
strategies_evidence_still_eligible: It's still eligible, but it isn't in the new portfolio. This doesn't establish why it left.
strategies_evidence_unavailable: There's not enough saved evidence to explain why it left.
strategies_evidence_select_company: Select a company to see its result and the rules it meets.
strategies_evidence_kept_positions: positions carried over from the previous portfolio
strategies_evidence_fixed_photo: selection using the snapshot fixed for this round
strategies_evidence_method_changed_note: The saved methodology changed afterward. This portfolio keeps the recipe used to form it.
strategies_evidence_photo_missing: The formation snapshot isn't available to verify the rules. Current data isn't substituted.
strategies_evidence_rule_version_unsuppo: This historical rule version can't be reproduced with the current catalog.
strategies_evidence_market_data: Data from {date}. Provisional return since {since}: {return}. Includes dividends and splits.
strategies_evidence_rules_verified: {verified} of {total} rules verified{unknown, plural, =0 {} other {; # without enough evidence}}.
strategies_evidence_no_verifiable_condit: No historical conditions can be verified.
strategies_evidence_missing_closes: Some intermediate closes are missing; the comparison uses the available endpoints for the period.
strategies_evidence_no_common_closes: Matching closes aren't available to compare this position with the S&P 500.
strategies_position_performance_help: Total return for each stock, including dividends and splits. It isn't the stock's contribution to results and doesn't establish causation.
strategies_comparable_positions: {comparable} of {total} positions can be compared over the same saved period.
strategies_formation_changes: What changed in the latest formation
strategies_no_exits: No exits between these two formed portfolios.
strategies_evidence_recipe_unavailable: The recipe fixed for this portfolio isn't available.
strategies_showcase_performance_note: First week (four closes) and four rounds with the last one in progress. Tap a period or drag across the curve.
strategies_chart_note: Return with dividends and daily closes, reset to 0 % at the start of the chosen period.
strategies_company_notes_source: Scores from the {date} scan, round {round}. They are the ones used to build this portfolio.
strategies_company_notes_none: That round did not save company scores. The portfolio was built with another method, which you can see in the Methodology tab.
